_readme: fix_from payload — findings carried from a previous review's report into the fix-only continuation (D-005). Copy the findings array of the previous report (or a bare array of items) and edit it before passing as the fix_from arg (file path or inline JSON). Rules the loader applies: items need where and what; evidence/severity/lens/impact/status default sensibly when absent; an item already marked fixStatus 'fixed' is dropped; items are re-sorted by severity. The two items below are examples of each case.

findings.what: Refund amount is computed before the currency conversion, so refunds in non-USD accounts are off by the conversion rate.
findings.evidence: amount = base * qty  # line 42 — conversion applied at line 55, after the refund object is built
findings.impact: Every non-USD refund returns the wrong amount; finance reconciliation fails daily until fixed.

findings.what: Dead legacy import block slows startup by 200ms.
findings.evidence: import six, collections  # line 10 — six unused elsewhere in the file
